notes.title: Graphical Update And Better Gameplay
notes.notes:
I Noticed The Games Graphics Looked Kind Of Bland And Honestly Outdated, So I Fixed It Up In Every Level And Tried My Best To Get The Lighting Better.

Colors Should Be More Vibrant, And There Is Now The Ability To Crouch And Sprint.
Rethinking Leaving The Game.

Keep The Community Strong For Me, I'll Keep On Working Unless I Get Burnout.

But Honestly This Update Was Fun.
Hope You Like The Graphics.

And Hope You Love The New Font!

From Newboon

notes.title: Story Mode / Final Update 2 Release Date
notes.notes:
Pickup Trash Simulator Story Mode Release Date:
Q4 2025

So, You Might Know About My Little Story Mode I'm Working On.
And If You Do, Good..

So Far Still Working On Getting The In Game Graphics Working With All This New Fangled Lighting, Lol.

But This Update Should Come Out If There's No Delays..

Q4 2025
So Between October 1st - December 31st This Year.

The Story Follows A Guy Named Tom, Who Has No Job And Is Newly Living On His Own.

It'll Be A Comedic Story.
I'm Planning To Voice Every Male Character. I'm Thinking All Audio Will Be English Only BUT I Will Probably Add A Bunch Of Languages For Subtitles.

I'm Not Trying To Hype It Up Too Much As I'm Not Sure How It Will Turn Out In The Final Cut, But It's Being Written Like A Movie.

So Yea, That's It.

I'm Taking Regular Breaks To Try To Avoid Burn Out, That Would Be The Reason It Would Get Delayed.

OH BTW Final Update 2 Patches Coming Out Soon.

notes.title: What's Coming In Final Update 2?
notes.notes:
So You Probably Saw 1/3 For The Last Update.

I'm Going To Keep The 3rd Update Mostly A Secret, But I Will Tell You What The Second One Is Because Of How Massive It Will Be For The Game.

I've Been Working On A Script For The Games Story Mode Which Will Be The 2nd Final Update,
The Story Won't Be Too Serious It's Mostly Comedic, I Don't Really Have A Planned Release Date But I Know If A Part Of It Isn't Good - Amazing Or Boring It'll Probably Be Cut Out.

I Will Also Probably Voice Almost ALL Characters.

The Story Mode Won't Be As Family Friendly As The Game Is Normally, There Won't Be Swearing Or Extreme Gore But There Will Be Some Comedic Violence And Barely Even Mild Language.

Since This Is A Big Update It Will Take Some Time, Especially Because I'm Putting As Much Effort Into It As I Can.

You Might Not Know This But I Model Everything In The Game Myself, Which Takes Time.

So Far I Made A Few Walls, A Window And A Door.

No Spoilers So That's All I Will Say.


Other Things Final Update 2 Will Add Is Patches For The Game Itself Like,

Classic Extra In Sandbox Mode,

Updated Town Extra In Sandbox Mode (With Basketball Nets And Basketballs),

Audio Fixes.


That's All For Now,

See Ya

- Newboon

notes.title: Pickup Trash Simulator Final Update (1/3)
notes.notes:
This Update Adds The Classic Extra, It Recreates The Look Of How The Original Game Looked.
This Update Is One Of The Three Final Updates Coming Out This Year. This Update Will Be The Smallest Out Of The Three.

One Of The Reasons I'm Leaving Game Development Is Because Of Storage Space, After The Update I Have 362 MB Left In My Drives All Together. Unreal Engine Takes Up A Lot Of Storage Even To Run.
Then To Build Lighting And Levels It's So Much For My PC.

This Update Adds A New Classic Mode And Basketball Hoops By Some Houses In The Town Extra.

notes.title: 7 Days Until Release
notes.notes:
[b]I Hope You[/b] Are All Ready For [i]Pickup Trash Simulator Remastered[/i] To Release To The Public In 7 Days On July 15th.

The Game Is Just Waiting For All Of You To Get Your Hands On It And Start Picking Up Trash. So I Just Wanted To Tell All Of You Who Wishlisted It Or Are Thinking Of Getting It, Thank You.

I May Be A Indie Game Developer Who Goes By Newboon Which Sometimes Gets Auto Corrected To Newborn Which I Think Is Kinda Funny, But Who Cares About That Stuff, You Are Here To Learn About The Funny Trash Game,

[b]Let Me Tell You About It.[/b]

My Game Pickup Trash Simulator Remastered Has ABUNCH Of Extras To Keep You Entertained, Plus Achievements That Can Keep You Playing For A Long While.

I Want You All To Trust Me When I Say This Game Is Worth The Play, Plus It's A New Free Game On Steam There's No Reason Not To Play It,

Well Unless Your On Mac Or Linux.

[b]On That Topic[/b] [b]Let Me Tell You About Game Support And Stuff.[/b]

Completely Honest I Do Have A Working Version Of The Game For [b]Linux[/b] BUT It's Not Ready For Release On [u]July 15th[/u] 2024, So Expect It To Release Later On As In [b][i]Late Q3[/i][/b] Which Is Just An Estimate Because The Linux Version Isn't Fully Optimized Or Tested Fully Either So I'd Like To Ask You Be Patient Linux Users.
Sorry [i]Mac[/i] Users.

[b]7 More Days Until Release,[/b]



[b][i]"Small Games, Small Brains."[/i][/b] -[b]Newboon[/b] [b]2022[/b]

notes.title: Huge Pre-Release UI Revamp
notes.notes:
[b]MAIN MENU[/b]

I Re-Arranged The Main Menu And Made A Settings Button Instead Of A Mini Settings At The Corner.

I Added Sound Effects For The Menus And Made Everything Look Sleeker And Better To Look At.


[b]SETTINGS[/b]

I Completely Reworked The Settings By Changing The Place To Access It To Be It's Own Menu.


[b]PAUSE MENU[/b]

I Just Added Sound Effects For The Pause Menu.



This Is A Huge Upgrade From The Original Which Lacked Any UI Elements,
I'd Call This A Win.

An Epic Patch I Guess.

-Newboon
